MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 9, 2026
  130 CHERRY AVE.
  BIXBY PARK SOCIAL HALL, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Robert Blair, Commissioner  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
  Theresa Marino, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  tamalyn.sayre@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54701  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, March 12, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54702  Recommendation to endorse the submission to approve a fee waiver for the Long
  Beach Rowing Association, in an amount not to exceed $560.00, for use of Marine
  Stadium for a National Learn to Row Day event on Saturday, June 5, 2026.
  (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54703  Recommendation to approve for submission to City Council the Marine Advisory
  Commission 2025 Annual Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54721  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54704  Recommendation to receive and file the Executive, Finance, and Ad Hoc “Point of
  Historical Interest” Committees status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 9, 2026
  130 CHERRY AVE.
  BIXBY PARK SOCIAL HALL, 2:30 PM

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
